name: PocketCurator
summary: Manages a user's own ROM collection from an EmulationStation-style interface.

notes: The release publishes an archive checksum, but the repository does not declare a license.
This candidate is not a ROM-download source; review must confirm that packaged behavior remains limited to user-owned files.
H700 compatibility, allowed write paths, and real-device testing are still required.

evidence.note: Release and checksum asset observed during candidate review; not approved for installation.
